The first entry reaction_id 20810 seems relevant: retro_smarts_template shows Cl-[S...]-[c] . [C...O...]-[NH2] etc. That seems to be the sulfonyl chloride + amine to sulfonamide. So we should use that template.

We need to apply it to the target molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template with molecule_smiles and template_id (maybe template_hash?). The tool expects template_id (string). Likely we can use template_hash as ID. Let's try apply_template with that hash.
